definitions.explanation: Land that is suitable for or actively used for growing crops. Refers to fields that have been prepared and maintained for agricultural use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耕地|こうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There is little arable land in this area.

examples.japanese: {耕地|こうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伐採|ばっさい}→伐採：08435_bassai⟧された。
examples.english: Forests were cut down to expand the cultivated land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{耕地|こうち}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られている→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has limited arable land area because it is so mountainous.
examples.notes: 耕地面積 = cultivated land area

notes:
USAGE: {耕地|こうち} specifically refers to land that has been worked and prepared for cultivation. It's more formal than ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (field) or ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ (rice paddy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耕地|こうち}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ (cultivated land area)
- {耕地|こうち}⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ (land consolidation)
- {耕地|こうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧ (to cultivate arable land)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧ (agricultural land - broader term)
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (vegetable field/dry field)
- ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ (rice paddy)
